|game_text=Deploy from under [[Scoundrel's Luck]] on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Scoundrel's Charm]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Scoundrel's Charm]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text). The Master List of 27 April 2013 ([[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata 2)]]) has the same words; the card image is current only because it was uploaded later, on its server's bulk upload date, which is the only date known for it.
* '''Original''' ([[Scoundrel's Charm]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012; the slip [[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Charm.png]] and the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelscharm-pre.gif]] print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 6, slip 35 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 29) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=29, page 29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=29 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013, in every list) reads “the top 3 cards of your Force pile” and “subtract 1 from an opponent's just-drawn destiny” (the slip has “three”, “Force Pile”, “from opponent's”). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1281_35">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top 3 cards of your Force pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from an opponent's just-drawn destiny.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 29)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Scoundrel's Charm]]) again, word for word: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later (this page) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-35-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelscharm-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Scoundrel's Charm]]) again, word for word: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
